acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce or disprove provider-file growth and FIFO replacement races on supported systems, retaining actual version, fixture, timeout and cleanup evidence.
If confirmed, repair the legacy loader under its owning contract and show bounded regular-file reads and refusal for special/replaced files while preserving ordinary EEP semantics.
Keep the new V1-0536 captured-input path distinct; a plan or passing new adapter does not close legacy behavior.
body: Observed during independent Gate A for V1-0536 on public25971bda1ca1664d8a546d751cb2bb9bbd454daf, Core1.0.0-rc.1 build163 / Tasksbuild202. Confirmed API/code facts: extevidence.Selection takes filenames (selection.go140), calls loadAll (section.go154), and load does pathname os.Stat followed by unbounded os.ReadFile (section.go216-225). readPinnedSource uses LimitReader but openRegular (pin.go250-273) stats before blocking os.Open. Expected bounded file admission should remain bounded and nonblocking if a file grows or is replaced with a FIFO between calls. Actual source structure leaves this race open; runtime reproduction NOT_RUN, so suspected defect rather than a confirmed exploit. Reproduction to add: controlled growth/replacement between Stat and Open with a bounded timeout and guaranteed descendant cleanup. No special file should hang or force unbounded allocation; same captured bytes must determine digest and decode. Deduplicated native searches FIFO and provider record; related V1-0388 concerns context-index .gitignore, not this loader. V1-0536 revised plan adds a separate single-capture SelectionCaptured route; that does not repair legacy loader callers. Evidence: /tmp/delta-revised-gate-a-review-v1.json and /tmp/delta-revised-plan.json revision2.
title: Investigate provider file capture races and allocation bounds in legacy EEP reads
